action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that HTTP::Tiny incorrectly forwarded credential headers
supplied by the caller, such as Authorization, Cookie and
Proxy-Authorization, when following cross-origin redirects, including
redirects from HTTPS to HTTP. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
obtain sensitive information.
isummary:
HTTP::Tiny could be made to expose sensitive information over the
network.
